Which one shows EQUAL parts? A) a bar split into 2 very different sizes  B) a circle split into 4 equal quarters  C) a square split into 3 different pieces  D) a strip torn into random bits. Answer with the letter.
method_steps: Which one shows EQUAL parts? → B) a circle split into 4 equal quarters
1. Fractions only work when every part is the SAME size.
2. B is split into 4 quarters that match — equal parts.
3. The others are split into pieces of different sizes, so no piece can be named as a fraction.

problem: Which can be named as 1/3? A) a cake in 3 equal parts  B) a cake in 3 unequal parts  C) a cake in 2 parts  D) a whole cake. Answer with the letter.
method_steps: EQUAL PARTS AND NAMING A FRACTION
Which can be named as 1/3? → A) a cake in 3 equal parts
1. 1/3 means ONE part out of THREE parts that are all the same size.
2. A has 3 equal parts, so one of them is 1/3.
3. B has 3 parts but they are unequal — no part is a third.
4. C has the wrong number of parts, and D is not split at all.
